variants.title: Дерево и графит
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: photorealistic architectural interior concept for an affordable business-class residential entrance.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and the sole authority for geometry and camera. Other inputs are MATERIAL/DETAIL STYLE references only, never their architecture or furniture.
Transform this simple render into a convincing, beautifully detailed real interior photograph. Preserve EXACT camera position, framing, aspect ratio, perspective, wall corners, ceiling height, floor boundary, both door openings and their original outlines. Left is a single solid staircase door; right is the existing double glazed door. Keep their size, location, leaf count, opening configuration and handles. Do not enlarge the room or openings. Overdoor decoration must be a separate fixed panel with a seam at the ORIGINAL door head, never a taller door leaf.
Common palette: light warm ivory matte walls, medium natural wood (not orange), restrained dark graphite, matte beige stone-look porcelain tile with plausible grout. Bright comfortable overall lighting, subtle warm accent light, realistic neutral white balance without yellow cast. Real material microtexture, convincing glass and contact shadows, straight architectural edges. Keep the simple flat ceiling and a practical linear ceiling luminaire in its original location. Preserve dark durable skirting.
Keep exact readable Russian wayfinding words "ЛЕСТНИЦА" above the left door and "ЛИФТ →" on the wall between doors, approximately their original positions; no additional text.
Use straightforward thin rectangular applied panels, visible assembly seams and standard-looking light fittings. No reception, furniture, plants, artwork, chandeliers, gold trim, luxury marble veins, curved structures, new niches/windows/doors or people. No collage, labels or watermark. Return one full-frame landscape interior photograph.
Variant 01, DOOR-FOCUSED COMPOSITION. Using image 2's wood and fine dark relief language, create an elegant medium-wood portal framing the left door and continuing above it to the ceiling. The door head remains at exactly its original level, with a visible horizontal joint separating the fixed overdoor panel. Incorporate a narrow vertically fluted graphite insert on the RIGHT SIDE of this portal as an applied decorative strip, not a new opening. Left door leaf is realistic medium natural wood. Keep the large wall between the doors mostly quiet light ivory, not a wall of wood. Keep the right glazed doorway's dark metal frame simple. Richness comes from proportion, joinery, texture and light, not extra objects.
